+++ b/test/marquee_web/components/demo_banner_test.exs
@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+defmodule MarqueeWeb.Components.DemoBannerTest do
+  use MarqueeWeb.ConnCase, async: true
+
+  import Phoenix.LiveViewTest
+
+  test "subscriber demo exposes an accessible dismiss button and keeps mobile navigation outside the banner" do
+    org = insert(:organization, features: %{"subscriber_demo" => true})
+    conn = build_conn() |> Map.put(:host, "#{org.slug}.localhost") |> post("/demo/subscriber")
+    {:ok, view, _html} = live(recycle(conn), "/")
+
+    assert has_element?(
+             view,
+             "[data-test=subscriber-demo-banner] button[data-test=subscriber-demo-dismiss][type=button][aria-label='Dismiss demo banner']"
+           )
+
+    assert has_element?(view, "[data-test=subscriber-demo-mobile-nav] a[href='/browse']")
+    assert has_element?(view, "[data-test=subscriber-demo-mobile-nav] a[href='/watchlist']")
+
+    refute has_element?(
+             view,
+             "[data-test=subscriber-demo-banner] [data-test=subscriber-demo-mobile-nav]"
+           )
+  end
+
+  test "ordinary viewers have no demo dismissal control" do
+    org = insert(:organization)
+    viewer = insert(:viewer, organization: org)
+    {:ok, view, _html} = live(conn_for_viewer(viewer), "/")
+    refute has_element?(view, "[data-test=subscriber-demo-dismiss]")
+  end
+
+  test "admin demo exposes a separate accessible dismissal action without removing reset and exit" do
+    org = build(:organization, demo_kind: :admin_sandbox)
+    html = render_component(&MarqueeWeb.Components.AdminDemo.bar/1, organization: org)
+    document = LazyHTML.from_fragment(html)
+
+    assert document
+           |> LazyHTML.filter("button[data-test=admin-demo-dismiss][type=button][aria-label='Dismiss demo banner']")
+           |> LazyHTML.to_tree()
+           |> Enum.any?()
+
+    for selector <- ["[data-test=admin-demo-reset]", "[data-test=admin-demo-exit]"] do
+      assert document |> LazyHTML.filter(selector) |> LazyHTML.to_tree() |> Enum.any?()
+    end
+  end
+
+  test "ordinary organizations have no admin demo dismissal control" do
+    html = render_component(&MarqueeWeb.Components.AdminDemo.bar/1, organization: build(:organization))
+    assert html |> LazyHTML.from_fragment() |> LazyHTML.filter("[data-test=admin-demo-dismiss]") |> LazyHTML.to_tree() == []
+  end
+end

+++ b/assets/js/demo_banner.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,71 @@
+const initializers = new WeakMap<Document, () => void>()
+
+/**
+ * Dismiss demo notices for this browser session, including static admin layouts.
+ * Reads data-demo-banner-key and data-demo-banner-dismiss; sends no server events.
+ * Listeners and the observer live for the document's lifetime, across LV patches.
+ */
+export function initializeDemoBanners(): void {
+  const initialized = initializers.get(document)
+  if (initialized) {
+    initialized()
+    return
+  }
+
+  const dismissed = new Set<string>()
+  const unsaved = new Set<string>()
+  const storageKey = (key: string) => `marquee:demo-banner:${key}`
+
+  const isDismissed = (key: string): boolean => {
+    try {
+      return sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey(key)) === "dismissed" || unsaved.has(key)
+    } catch {
+      return dismissed.has(key)
+    }
+  }
+
+  const restoreBanners = () => {
+    document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-demo-banner-key]").forEach(banner => {
+      const hidden = isDismissed(banner.dataset.demoBannerKey!)
+      if (banner.hidden !== hidden) banner.hidden = hidden
+    })
+  }
+
+  document.addEventListener("click", event => {
+    if (!(event.target instanceof Element)) return
+    const button = event.target.closest<HTMLButtonElement>("button[data-demo-banner-dismiss]")
+    const banner = button?.closest<HTMLElement>("[data-demo-banner-key]")
+    const key = banner?.dataset.demoBannerKey
+    if (!banner || !key) return
+
+    dismissed.add(key)
+    try {
+      sessionStorage.setItem(storageKey(key), "dismissed")
+      unsaved.delete(key)
+    } catch {
+      unsaved.add(key)
+    }
+
+    const hadFocus = banner.contains(document.activeElement)
+    banner.hidden = true
+    if (hadFocus) {
+      const main = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("main")
+      if (main && !banner.contains(main)) {
+        const hadTabIndex = main.hasAttribute("tabindex")
+        if (!hadTabIndex) main.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1")
+        main.focus({preventScroll: true})
+        if (!hadTabIndex) main.removeAttribute("tabindex")
+      }
+    }
+  })
+  window.addEventListener("phx:page-loading-stop", restoreBanners)
+  const observer = new MutationObserver(restoreBanners)
+  observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
+    childList: true,
+    subtree: true,
+    attributes: true,
+    attributeFilter: ["hidden", "data-demo-banner-key"],
+  })
+  initializers.set(document, restoreBanners)
+  restoreBanners()
+}
